assets.prompt: Create an accurate botanical specimen asset sheet for a Korean elementary science game. Exactly THREE separate leaves in a clean horizontal row, each isolated on a fully TRANSPARENT background in its own equal-width third of the image, with at least 10 percent clear empty gutter between specimens. Beautiful tactile dimensional botanical rendering halfway between realistic plant specimens and premium friendly 3D educational game art. Soft diffuse light, detailed veins, true leaf thickness, believable natural green color, crisp recognizable silhouette. LEFT: one fresh green MAPLE (Acer) leaf with a single leaf blade divided into FIVE to SEVEN distinct pointed palmately arranged LOBES, clearly serrated small teeth along its outer margins, veins radiating from one point near its thin petiole. MIDDLE: one small bundle of PINE (Pinus) NEEDLE LEAVES: exactly a pair of very thin long dark-green needles emerging from ONE tiny brown basal sheath, two clean separate narrow needles clearly visible along almost their whole length, no branch, no pine cone, no broad leaf, no grass tuft. RIGHT: one CAMELLIA (Camellia japonica) leaf: single thick glossy dark-green oval ELLIPTIC leaf blade with a pointed tip, clear central midrib and smaller curved branching veins, very small subtle serrated teeth along edge, short thin petiole. The three species must remain entirely separate specimens, absolutely no hybrid, no combining features, no touching, no shared stem. Each specimen fully visible with generous transparent padding; no clipped tips or stalks. No soil, no pot, no flower, no tree, no labels, no typography, no words, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no frames, no watermark. Very minimal soft contact shading only.
